authoredNote: Lines computed from `nl -ba` of the committed fixture; the positive rows pin BOTH metadata.owner and metadata.ownerEvidence, and the negative row pins the ABSENT case (`meta.owner: null`) so an over-claim fails just as loudly as a miss.
rationale: PINS THE GENERIC-PROPAGATION CLASS: the member `value: T` is resolved to the INSTANTIATED argument `Widget` from `new Box<Widget>()`; the evidence class is `generic` (the type came through the type arguments, not a literal member type). The negative row is the same call shape on an object whose type states no instantiation — it must carry NO owner (`meta.owner: null`).
